This update improves resize cancellation, canvas fitting and HEIC saving, with a few Linux packaging improvements.

### Fixes

- Cancelling a large resize now stops the running resize process and keeps the document unchanged. Related to issue 207.
- Toolbar Fit now behaves like the View menu and Ctrl+0 instead of jumping to 100%. Zoom-out limits follow the canvas and window size. Related to issue 211.
- HEIC saving explains PaintFE's size limit before encoding and blocks oversized exports. Both HEIC and HEIF filename extensions are accepted. Related to issue 196.
- Linux packages provide both command spellings, with an updated desktop entry and package build fixes. Related to issue 187.

### Interface and documentation

- Added HEIC library setup instructions in Preferences > Optional features.
- Clarified Linux runtime and plugin dependencies.
